predicate_basis.healed_turn: Original restored_health(state, execution player, current turn) > 0.
predicate_basis.other_mech: Another live active friendly minion, excluding the physical source, using current mech tribes.
predicate_basis.held_shadow: Own current physical hand spell with the current definition Shadow school.
predicate_basis.held_dragon: Own current physical hand tribe query through has_any_tribe, preserving unknown-type errors.
predicate_basis.hero_damaged_turn: Original hero_damage_taken(state, execution player, current turn) > 0.
predicate_basis.held_big_spell: Own current hand spell with a full unselected current cost quote >= 5; no payment or consumption.

suffix_policy: Only the effect after the actual & divider. Native self effects retain their own live-target/reference behavior; a dead carrier is not resurrected. Equipment and discovery belong to the accepted execution player.
native_bridge_policy: Preserve each full native definition and original Battlecry id; condition and effect split only for derived assembled faces.
